title: security: RBAC v2 enforce KMS region pinning, audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: customers have asked for stronger guarantees that customer-managed KMS keys and region residency settings are respected during inference. This PR hardens RBAC v2 policy evaluation to enforce KMS region pinning and improves audit logging so residency decisions are traceable. Summary of changes: 1) policy evaluator: add deterministic KMS region pinning checks and an enforcement mode behind feature flag rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce, 2) audit: add kms_region and residency_reason fields to audit events and ensure events are emitted on allow/deny and fallback decisions, 3) DB migration: add schema for persisted residency_decisions and a lightweight index for queries, migration implemented idempotently and guarded to run only on main master, 4) integration tests: add e2e tests that exercise cross-region key scenarios and fallback paths, 5) docs: update RBAC v2 spec and migration notes; rollout: gradual canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on elevated metric thresholds. Motivation: reduce silent data residency violations and give SRE/security better telemetry to diagnose KMS misconfigurations. Testing: unit tests + integration tests added, manual staging verification of audit payloads, security scan passed. Rollout plan and safety: feature flag default is audit-only for 48 hours, then enforcement for accounts that opt in; migration is non-blocking and reversible; if enforcement causes unexpected denials we will revert the feature flag and patch policy logic. Related work: ENG-8721, SEC-341, SUP-1284. No customer-facing API changes beyond optional enforcement flag.
